subject: SOC CONTAINER & BB VESSEL COST FROM CHINA
body:
Dear Cosmos Whales,

We are having regular shipments from China (POL: Shanghai, Qingdao, Tianjin). We are planning to load all SOC containers in BB vessel from China to Navico Marine Jetty in Lagos (Sterling own port).
Our volume will be 300 to 400 containers per vessel. 85 - 90 % will be 40'FT and 10 - 15 % only 20'GP. Cargo weight will be approx. 20 - 27 Mts.

Suppliers will pick the empty SOC for stuffing and will offload all the containers at below POL's based on our instructions.

We need your quote based on below details.


  1.
SOC container rate for 20'GP, 40'GP and 40'HC.
  2.
SOC container availability at Shanghai, Qingdao, Tianjin for empty pickup.
  3.
BB vessel rate for loading 300 - 400 containers from Shanghai & Tianjin to Navico Marine Jetty, Lagos.
  4.
BB vessel rate for loading 300 - 400 containers from Zhangjiagang & Longkou to Navico Marine Jetty, Lagos.

Kindly share your vessel frequency for every month to plan all shipments at China.



Regards,

Ramesh Mohan

Senior Executive - Freight Forwarding,

Clearing & Forwarding
